name: 76426 · Bridgeport, TX
findings: ZIP 76426 (Bridgeport) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76426 (Bridgeport) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
